sloka: युष्मान् पाप आत्मकान् हंतुम् विप्रकारान् महाहवे ।ऋषीणाम् तु नियोगेन प्राप्तो अहम् सशर आसनः ॥३-२०-९॥
transliteration: yuṣmān pāpa ātmakān haṁtum viprakārān mahāhave ।ṛṣīṇām tu niyogena prāpto aham saśara āsanaḥ ॥3-20-9॥

translations.english: I came here equipped with bows, arrows and weapons, asked by ascetics to kill in the battle sinners like you who are offending them.
